parameters.query: INSERT INTO mirofish_verdict (run_id, verdict_ts, schema_ok, bias, confidence, event_risk, horizon_hours, risk_score, evidence, adapter_version, raw) VALUES ('{{ $json.run_id }}', '{{ $json.verdict_ts }}', {{ $json.schema_ok }}, '{{ $json.bias }}', {{ $json.confidence }}, '{{ $json.event_risk }}', {{ $json.horizon_hours }}, {{ $json.risk_score === undefined || $json.risk_score === null ? 1 : $json.risk_score }}, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.evidence) }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.adapter_version }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING;
